record.question:
The CoBRA (Commando Battalion for Resolute Action) battalions deployed to Manipur in June
    2026 were primarily relocated from which operational roles in other states/union?
options: Border guarding operations in Indo-Bangla border
Reserved personnel from VIP and VVIP security duties
